title: TACP v0.2.0 Closed Mission Bundle
description: Structural validation for specs/tacp-v0.2.md and its inherited v0.1 rules. Validates closed mission records, not runtime permissions or actual enforcement.
$comment: Use a strict JSON parser rejecting duplicate keys and non-finite numbers, with date-time format assertion enabled. Separate v0.2 semantic validation is REQUIRED: identity/reference/type/order checks, closure last, sequential revisions and rounds, latest assessment/review bindings, issue continuity and downgrades, structural action equality, same-state comparison and kind comparability, target basis membership, authorization status versus its time bounds, matching named checks, dispatch window bounds, observation/check freshness, no planning after the gate, deadline/resource limits, reason-code support, reservation binding, and valid state transitions. The v0.1 validator does not implement these v0.2 semantics. External evidence references and fixture extensions are untrusted claims; runtime authorization, revocation, atomic state enforcement, and deduplication require deployment validation. No remote schema references are used.

reference.description: Opaque record or deployment reference. Resolution, type, order, and authenticity require separate validation.

utc_timestamp.$comment: Enable date-time format assertion. The pattern enforces UTC syntax; format checking must reject invalid calendar dates. Relative time ordering is semantic validation.

review_check.$comment: Empty evidence_refs is allowed only when finding explicitly remains unverified. This natural-language requirement needs semantic review.

dispatch_check.title: TACP dispatch_check record
dispatch_check.$comment: A passing record never authorizes dispatch by itself. Runtime revalidation and atomic prerequisite enforcement remain mandatory.
